Navratri and Durga Puja Celebrations Across India

Navratri and Durga Puja are celebrated across India over nine nights, with distinct regional variations in traditions and customs. These festivals mark a period of religious observance and cultural expression, involving different culinary practices and ways of marking the nine nights.
